title: Ruins — Hazard (why it's still full of loot)

entries.value: Essence-radiation / leaking demesne — lingering causes mutation; motes drain or surge wildly
Wyld taint pooled in the lower halls — shapes shift, mutations, the map won't hold still
Awakened First Age automata still on patrol — obey dead orders; attack intruders lacking the sigil
Creeping shadowland necrosis — the dead walk; living Essence rots; a soul-gate yawns
A bound demon, seal failing — whispers bargains; one cracked sigil from freedom
Failing geomantic ward — floods, fire, or collapse cycles on a timer
Immaculate seals over the core — break them and the Wyld Hunt WILL hear of it
Resident behemoth (sleeping or hunting) — too big to fight; route around it or wake it
Temporal eddy (First Age stasis) — rooms frozen mid-disaster; time-debt on exit
Toxic alchemical miasma — poison gas, corroded floors, no open flame
Rival claimants already inside (see Inhabitants) — a tomb-robbing crew got here first
Structural ruin — every loud noise risks a cave-in; sound matters
Cursed grave-ward — takers sicken / are marked / are followed home
Hungry ghosts bound to the place — feed on the living's breath; placated only by rite
A weather-engine stuck 'on' — perpetual storm, blizzard, or killing heat inside
Feral elementals (the engine's old labor) — territorial, treat the PC as a thief
Drowned / flooded levels — the prize is underwater; tides, pressure, things below
The site itself is hostile (living manse) — doors close, halls rearrange, it wants to keep you
